verdicts.reason: Both candidates are unusable. They have the same failures: the hero photo of the mother and child is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail floating on the left, and the yellow 'LOVE. CARE. KIDS.' panel is a small sliver in the middle of a mostly empty white banner. The headline text is barely readable, the thin yellow frame and accent bars are gone or reduced to specks in the corner, and nothing has been rearranged for a left-to-right banner. B is only marginally less bad because its headline text in the yellow panel is slightly larger.
